title: Ledger entry
description: One line of ledger.jsonl in the private store (design parts 5.4 and 13.1). Append-only: corrections are new events that reference the old one. The ledger is internal as a whole, so lines carry no classification. Events: the ten of part 5.4, plus run-started and lease-taken for orchestrator continuity (part 13.1). dispatched is recorded before the harness is called; started is recorded when the harness has accepted the dispatch, and carries its harness_ref. Version 2 (HITLD-82) renamed claimed to started, question to asked, released to unclaimed, outcome to result and handle to harness_ref; the reader takes a version 1 line in the old names, permanently, since the ledger is never rewritten.

id.description: Unique per event, so applying an event is idempotent.

run.description: The run this event belongs to; on run-started, the new run's ID.

role.description: executor, acceptance, adversary, reviewer, triager, and so on.

result.description: How the attempt ended. For reported: done, partial or blocked. For verified: pass or fail.

defects.description: For a failed verification: the defect count.

tokens.description: From the completion notice; null when the harness does not report usage.

corrects.description: The ID of an earlier event this one corrects.

session.description: The orchestrator session: on run-started and lease-taken, the session that now holds the lease.

host.description: The machine the executor runs on (dispatched, claimed), or the orchestrator's machine (run-started, lease-taken).

harness.description: The harness adapter ID, on started.

harness_ref.description: The harness's own reference for the dispatch (an agent ID, a process ID, a task URL), on started.

serial_resources.description: Serial resources the dispatch holds (design part 13.2), on dispatched.

decision.description: The decision item a question or answer is about.

policy_hash.description: On run-started: the hash of the effective policy.json the run started with.

scope.description: On run-started: what the run covers.
